origin.origins_backgrounds_two.greenwitc: Greenwitches sɛan taẓuri tagamant akken ad d-ssewḥen tiɣawsiwin.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.hunter.de: Iṣeggaden sselmaden-d s tẓuri n tneccabt.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.swashbuck: Llant lemdent aṭas n yifecka n uḍellaɛ.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.trader.de: Imzenziyen ssnen amek ara beddlen tiɣawsiwin.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.miner.des: Axeddim sɣur Master Miner yesselmed-asen ad d-ɣzen s tɣawla neɣ ad ǧǧen iman-nsen deg uɣebbar n weẓru.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.blacksmit: Aɣ-d-yawi lqecc yelhan, d ayen yesɛan azal ugar ɣef wamek i t-nwan kra.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.disenchan: Takebbanit n Disenchanters tettarra ddehn-is ɣer tukksa n tzemmar ur nettwaḥwaǧ ara.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.cook.name: Anelmad n Cook
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.cook.desc: Ahat mačči d imsewwi amatu, maca ur k-ssemɣayen ara. S lɣeṛḍ.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.sentry.de: Zemren ad ilin s ttawil cwiṭ, maca zemren ad kemmlen cwiṭ.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.bounty_hu: Ma teḥwaǧeḍ ttbut n tmettant, ad ak-t-id-fken.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.pickpocke: Ahat yessefk ad tḥerzeḍ tiɣawsiwin-ik s wazal-nsent.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.acrobat.d: Ticeqqufin ur sɛint ara anamek ɣer Acrobat
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.butcher.d: Ssnen amek ara gezmen war ma sruḥen aksum.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.alchemist: Yettfuǧǧuǧu tazmert mi ara itess tiẓidanin.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.street_ra: Akken i d-kkren deg yiberdan, lemden amek ara kksen aɛebbuḍ-nsen.
Aɛekkaz n tkerrist yuɣal d taɣult tis snat i yiḥeckulen.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.angler.de: Ama seg uɣerrabu neɣ seg ugemmaḍ, amseṭṭay n lḥut yeṭṭef dima ayen yelhan akk.
